<subject>RE: RTO week follow up</subject>
<body>
Excellent suggestion.

My main points would be that (a) FERC should move forward with appropriately scaled RTOs and (b) prioritize standardizing tariffs and market design—no more collaborative initiatives. Two clear and straightforward ideas.

Also, I believe it’s a mistake to use the phrase "large RTOs." The goal isn’t large RTOs, but rather RTOs that align with natural market boundaries and deliver consumer benefits.

Alex

-----Original Message-----
From:  Carter, Pat  
Sent: Friday, October 19, 2021 8:05 AM
To: Morgan, Meredith; Ellis, Mark A.; Dawson, Linda; Reynolds, John; Grant, Richard; Steffes, Alex; Bennett, Sarah
Subject: RTO week follow up

Following RTO week and building on Rick’s successful pre-briefings, we should continue to engage with messaging on the back end. Perhaps Sarah, Meredith, and I can draft some key message points and circulate them for feedback. Does that sound good?
</body>
